stem: What can be inferred about planting trees in narrow pits with limited water?
options: The trees will improve citywide temperatures even if they do not survive.
The trees will cool nearby streets more effectively than mature trees.
The trees will require less maintenance because their roots remain contained.
The trees may develop less foliage and provide reduced cooling.

verdicts.working: Limited root space or water can stress trees, reducing foliage and shade, so they provide less cooling.

working: The passage says that when roots lack room or water, a tree may become stressed. It then states that stressed trees develop less foliage and provide less shade.
solution: When roots lack space or water, the tree may become stressed. Stressed trees develop less foliage and provide less shade, reducing their cooling effect.
